reason_verbatim: Stage 20 A (original panel, post hoc) shows where the difference between E1 held fixed and E1 re-estimated lies. Over all eight patterns at 3 LT the re-estimated error is 7.2–7.9%, against 1.5–2.3% held fixed. Over the seven zero-mean patterns it is 0.8–1.5% re-estimated, against 0.4–1.6% held fixed. The difference therefore sits in the uniform decrease, the only action that changes the mean forcing. B3 and R3 were written before this was known, and test only the seven zero-mean patterns. Both stay unchanged; this amendment adds the all-eight reading the original panel supports.
